title: Future Juice Butterscotch Custard  Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Future Juice’s Butterscotch Custard is a luxuriously rich blend that pairs deep, caramelised Butterscotch with the smooth, velvety taste of classic Custard. The Butterscotch delivers an indulgent, buttery sweetness with hints of brown sugar, perfectly complemented by the thick, creamy Custard base. This fusion creates a warm and comforting vape, offering a decadent dessert experience with every puff. Blended at 70% VG / 30% PG, this high-VG e-liquid is designed for sub-ohm vaping, producing dense clouds and full-bodied flavour. Ideal for high-powered vape kits and sub-ohm tanks, it provides a satisfyingly smooth and creamy vape. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, while nic salt shots offer a milder throat hit compared to freebase nicotine. Future Juice is a UK-based e-liquid manufacturer dedicated to crafting premium blends with bold, layered flavours. Their shortfill range combines classic dessert and fruit-inspired profiles, designed for vapers who enjoy rich, satisfying e-liquids.
